verdict.rationale: Kong offers a dedicated AI Gateway product with explicit governance for LLM/MCP traffic: multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure, etc.), token/rate limiting via plugins, semantic security/guards, MCP traffic security and observability, and a Catalog for governing AI Models/MCP servers/agents. This is well documented across first-party docs and GitHub repo descriptions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation specifically of the AI/MCP governance features (the only community evidence found relates to an unrelated routing bug, not AI Gateway behavior).
